(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder selected from the group consisting of epoxy and __a thermally conductive solder paste__; and a solvent.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __that is a microelectronic component__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __by heating the component surface to a temperature sufficient to vaporize the solvent__.
